personality_notes: Rogue, sneaky, witty, always looking for angles and exits

first_meet_generic: Who are you? And more importantly, what do you have worth taking?
Senna. I acquire things. Sometimes people notice.
You're... different. I like different. Different has value.
This is either a trap or an opportunity. Which is it?
barrelman: Barrels. Good for hiding. Good for smuggling.
Got any with false bottoms? Asking for a friend.
snakecharmer: Mr. Whiskers? Cute name. Deadly pet. I like it.
Keep him away from my pockets. He might find things.
You trust a snake? Brave. Or stupid.
lucha: Mask hides identity. Smart. But distinctive.
Strong. But strength makes noise. I prefer quiet.
The cape is a liability. Easy to grab.
Wrestle? No thanks. I fight to win, not perform.
ironchef: Cooking in armor. No one suspects the chef.
Loud. Very loud. Good cover for other activities.
trenchcoat: Mystery is a business model. What's your angle?
You know things. Information is currency.
sumo: Low center. Hard to knock over. Impressive.
Stillness is patience. Patience is dangerous.
Wouldn't fight you. Wouldn't need to.
You block doors just by standing there. Useful.
foodboys: Which one? Doesn't matter. Both busy.
Every town? Supply chain knowledge. Valuable.
Can you poison chili? Asking for... research.
coolcat: Jazz covers sounds. Good for sneaking.
Sunglasses hide the eyes. Eyes tell truths.
What's under the cool? Everyone has angles.
pigman: Inn has multiple exits? Good. Always need exits.
Pork is fine. Information is better.
Guests talk. You listen. What do you know?
Room with a window. And a fire escape.
tunneler: Your back hurts? Try lighter loads.
Found anything valuable down there? Share?
bush: That's a bush. Why are we-- wait. Clever.
You're hiding. Professionally? Or just shy?
I could use a bush like you. For reasons.
aeronaut: Quiet? Mostly. Wind covers noise. Good.
How high can you go? Asking for... sightseeing.
Ever drop things? From way up?
onionboss: Layers. Like your namesake. What's underneath?
astronaut: Rather stay dry. Where I can run.
conductor: On schedule? Predictable. Predictable is exploitable.
Where does it go? Everywhere? Good.
shoewoman: Shoes. Quiet ones. That's what I need.
Desert-ready soles. Good for sand. And rooftops.
Can I run silently? That's the only question.
Give me two pairs. No questions.
signguy: Signs mark routes. I use them. Sometimes change them.
Hand-painted. Takes time. Time to... observe.
Ever make wrong-way signs? For... artistic reasons?
Your work is everywhere. So are my... activities.
cobra: Snakes don't judge. They just strike. I respect that.
barrelgob: Living in a barrel. Mobile hiding spot.
Scavenger. Finds things. Sells things. My kind.
What's in the barrel? Anything valuable?
I could use a barrel. For storage.
twins: Two bodies. One target? Or two?
Finish each other's... heists? No? Should try it.
sunandmoon: Fortune teller. Knows things. Or fakes it.
Predict my future? 'Don't get caught.' Good advice.
Stars don't care. But people who read them do.
